_ghi_chu: 8 nhân vật cho trang web. Sửa mô tả tiếng Anh tuỳ ý (prompt gửi cho Gemini). 'portrait_outfit' = trang phục trong ảnh chân dung (uniform/casual). 'pick' = số ảnh chân dung cô chọn (1 hoặc 2) để làm ảnh mẫu cho bảng tư thế; để null thì dùng ảnh 1. 'color' = màu nền avatar tròn.
style: A bright, saturated editorial magazine cut-out photograph. Photorealistic: it must look like a real photo of a real teenager, sharp focus, soft even studio lighting, vivid colours, natural skin texture.
background: Background: a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) filling the whole frame, with no shadows, no gradient, no floor, no background objects and no vignette. Leave clear green space above the head and on both sides of the body. Nothing green or green-tinted on the person (no green clothes, accessories or props). No text, no logo, no watermark, no border.
original: This is an original fictional person who must not resemble any real actor, singer, influencer or public figure.
uniform_girl: a Vietnamese secondary school uniform: a crisp white short-sleeved collared shirt tucked into a navy-blue knee-length pleated skirt, a small school badge on the chest pocket
uniform_boy: a Vietnamese secondary school uniform: a crisp white short-sleeved collared shirt tucked into navy-blue trousers, a small school badge on the chest pocket
poses: waving hello with one hand raised, big friendly smile
holding a smartphone in one hand and looking at it with a smile
wearing over-ear headphones, eyes half closed, happily listening
writing in a small notebook held in one hand, pen in the other hand, concentrating
pointing one index finger straight up as if having a great idea, eyebrows raised
